newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul receives three bids for subway link.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul receives three bids for subway link.

text.p: Istanbul city council said on Thursday it had received three bids from international consortia in a second tender for the electro-mechanisation of a subway line.
A consortium comprising ABB Traction AB, Turkey's Yapi Merkezi and Adtranz, a joint venture of ABB and Daimler-Benz AG, was among the groups to place a bid by the 10 a.m. (0800 GMT) deadline.

Tenders were also received from a group led by France's Cegelec with Cengiz Construction and Albayrak A.S., and another consortium led by Canadian Bombardier Inc with Gama Industry, Poyraz Construction and SNC Lavacian.

A previous tender awarded to a consortium led by Turk Siemens, Simko, another Siemens joint-venture in Istanbul and state-owned railway carriage-maker Tuvasas was cancelled in August because the group did not sign a detailed technical agreement in time. The contract had been worth $224 million.
The city aims to complete the link by the end of 1998. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
